absent: Exact numeric values of limits, error codes, capability bits, and selector constants are not visible in these fragments.
Full transparent huge page disable update beyond the truncated guard acquisition is absent.
Remainder of the subreaper propagation file beyond the first part is absent.
Concrete semantics of speculation control, shadow stack, and branch landing pad operations beyond default rejection are absent.
System wide open file ceiling value and task size and minimum mapped address values are absent.
Security hook decision logic and namespace capability evaluation internals are absent.
Process CPU timer arming details and resource usage fill details are absent.
Task list, grace period, address space lock, and semaphore implementation details are absent.

findings.text: Domain name control updates the calling UTS namespace label after confirming administrative privilege in the related user namespace and confirming the caller length lies within the allowed span, with user fault reported without state change.

Current task limit query and limit install share a common helper that validates the resource selector, optionally captures the prior pair, and optionally installs a new pair, reporting user copy faults separately from validation failures.

Cross task limit control locates a target by virtual process identifier with zero meaning self, checks read versus write permission intent, guards against thread group exit for foreign groups, reuses the common helper, and converts the old pair to wide form for user return.
Compat width limit set and query translate between compat infinity encoding and native infinity encoding in both directions, clamping oversized native values to compat infinity on return.
Legacy limit query variants return the stored pair clamped to the signed narrow maximum, with native and compat user layouts handled separately.
Resource usage query accepts only self, children, and thread selectors, rejecting other selectors as invalid, and delivers either native or compat layout depending on caller width.
File creation mask control atomically exchanges the caller file system mask after restricting the new value to permission bits, returning the prior mask to the caller.

Memory identity controls allow querying the descriptor size or installing code, data, break, stack, argument, and environment boundaries plus auxiliary vector content and executable reference, gated by range, ordering, and privilege checks.

Ancillary process controls provide anonymous virtual area naming, deny write execute mode query and latch, auxiliary vector snapshot, and transparent huge page disable query and update, each rejecting unexpected trailing arguments.
Thread identifier address helper exists in two build variants, one publishing the clear child thread identifier pointer to user space and the other rejecting the request as invalid.

Architecture override points for speculation control, shadow stack status and locking, and branch landing pad state and locking default to invalid argument, allowing platforms to provide real behavior.
A resource selector at or beyond the known limit count is rejected as invalid, and a proposed current value exceeding its proposed maximum is rejected as invalid.

Raising a maximum above its stored value requires resource control privilege and approval from the security hook, and the open file maximum additionally may not exceed the system wide open file ceiling.

When both old and new pairs are requested, the stored pair is captured before installation, and a finite processor time current value arms the per process processor timer when timer support is built in.
Compat infinity maps to native infinity on input and native infinity maps to compat infinity on output, with values above compat infinity clamped to compat infinity on return.
Legacy queries clamp both current and maximum to the signed narrow maximum before copying to user space.

Wide infinity detection uses equality against the wide infinity marker on wide word builds and a threshold at or beyond the unsigned long maximum on narrow word builds, with conversions mapping between native and wide infinities accordingly.

Access to self limits needs no extra permission, while access to another task needs either full real effective and saved user and group identity match or resource control capability in the target user namespace, plus security hook approval distinguishing read and write intent.
Successful domain name install mixes the supplied bytes into the device randomness pool, zero fills the remainder of the stored field, and emits a proc notification for the domain name.

Memory map validation requires every boundary to lie within the allowed user span from the minimum mapped address up to the task size, requires ordered start end pairs with code strictly ordered and others non decreasing, and requires break and data extent containment within the data limit.

Map install requires an exact descriptor size match, rejects an auxiliary size without a pointer or beyond the saved vector capacity, forces the final auxiliary pair to null, and requires checkpoint restore capability plus a regular executable file with execute permission for executable reference change.

Single field memory identity updates require resource control privilege, an address inside the allowed user span, and for stack argument and environment fields presence of a covering virtual area, otherwise reporting fault.
Child subreaper propagation marks unmarked descendants and returns a positive indication to continue descent, while already marked subtrees and child reaper pid namespace roots prune descent.

Deny write execute mode accepts only known bits, forbids no inherit without refuse exec gain, requires architecture support, rejects trailing arguments, and once set forbids change to any different value.
Transparent huge page disable query reports unset as zero and set as latched with an optional except advised modifier, while update forbids flags when enabling and forbids unknown flags.
Virtual area control supports only the anonymous name sub operation and rejects other sub operations as invalid.
Auxiliary vector retrieval returns the full saved vector size while copying only the caller requested prefix, reporting user fault on copy failure.
Domain name mutation holds the UTS semaphore in write form across lookup, copy into the live name structure, notification, and release.
Limit array read and mutation hold the group leader guard across validation of privilege, security approval, old capture, and new install.
Cross thread limit access holds the task list read guard while confirming the target remains alive, ensuring the group leader pointer stays stable across the shared helper call.

Process identifier lookup for cross task limits runs inside a read side grace period with a held task reference before release, returning search failure when absent or permission failure before referencing.

Memory boundary install and single field update hold the address space read guard plus the argument spin guard across validation and store, while auxiliary vector replacement via task guard and huge page disable via killable write guard use their own ordering.
Native, compat, and wide limit structures each carry a current and maximum pair with distinct infinity encodings and width dependent clamping on conversion.

Memory map descriptor carries code start and end, data start and end, break start and current break, stack start, argument start and end, environment start and end, auxiliary pointer and size, and executable descriptor with a negative sentinel meaning absent.
Address space identity mirrors the descriptor boundaries in live fields plus a fixed size saved auxiliary vector whose final pair is always null terminated.
Resource usage layouts exist in native and compat forms selected by caller width, sharing the same selector validation before fill.
Task and signal state expose a group leader pointer, a per resource limit array in signal state, subreaper and has child subreaper flags, and a clear child thread identifier pointer.

Cross task limit flow proceeds from user buffer parse and conversion, through grace period lookup and permission check, to optional foreign group guarding, shared limit update, wide conversion of old values, user copy back, and reference release.

Memory identity dispatch first handles map size query and full map install when checkpoint restore support is built in, otherwise enforces privilege and routes to executable reference, auxiliary vector, or single field paths with validation before commit.
Deny write execute state latches from unset to a chosen valid combination and thereafter only repeats of the same value succeed, with query reflecting the latched combination.
User buffer copy failures report fault without applying partial limit, map, mask, or usage updates, except where old values were already captured locally before the final copy back.
Out of range selectors, lengths, addresses, sizes, and unknown sub operations report invalid argument, including oversized map descriptors and auxiliary payloads.
Absent targets and missing covering areas report search failure or fault respectively, with foreign group exit racing handled by liveness recheck under guard.

Privilege and security denials report permission failure, covering namespace administration for domain names, resource control for limit raises and memory identity, and checkpoint restore for executable reference changes.
Saved auxiliary vector install in the full map path is intentionally lockless and may expose a torn snapshot to concurrent readers, a documented trade off to avoid extra locking.
Huge page disable update uses a killable write guard and reports interruption when killed while waiting, leaving prior state unchanged.
Limit selectors include file count, processor time, and data extent among a bounded set, with distinct native, compat, and wide infinity markers and a system wide open file ceiling.
Resource usage selectors distinguish self, children, and thread scopes.
Mask control restricts new values to user group and other permission bits.

Memory identity selectors cover code, data, break, stack, argument, environment, auxiliary vector, executable file, full map, and map size query, with auxiliary termination by null entries and absent executable indicated by a negative sentinel.
Deny write execute flags distinguish refuse exec gain from no inherit, and huge page disable flags distinguish full disable from except advised behavior.
Input output flusher mode combines memory allocation no input output with local throttle semantics.
Domain name length bound, permission bit mask, virtual area anonymous name selector, and limit read versus write security intents form part of the user visible contract.
